E1.evidence: Reporter gives a full reproducer node and the wrong `ros2 param dump` output; maintainer fujitatomoya reproduced it on rolling and confirmed the cause: "if empty result returns from parameter service, it will handle `# Parameter not set` like character array, that leads to this weird printing." (https://github.com/ros2/ros2/issues/1517)

E2.evidence: The ros2param `dump` verb (ros2cli repo) calls the list_parameters and get_parameters services of the reporter's node, whose parameter service is implemented by rclpy's ParameterService. At rclpy 4.1.4 `_get_parameters_callback` answers with an empty values list whenever one requested parameter raises ParameterUninitializedException (`response.values = node.get_parameters([])`), while GetParameters.srv declares "List of values which is the same length and order as the provided names. If a parameter was not yet set, the value will have PARAMETER_NOT_SET as the type." The consumer at ros2cli 0.25.4 maps an empty values list to the string '# Parameter not set' and zips it with the parameter names. The wrong value crosses the service boundary; a peer that follows the srv convention would not trigger it. Not wiring, build, or firmware.

E3.evidence: PAIR: the get_parameters response produced by the node's rclpy parameter service is consumed by `ros2 param dump`.

E4.evidence: Observed wrong output: "`ros2 param dump` reports that `param_1` is set to `#` and `param_2` is set to ` `" (https://github.com/ros2/ros2/issues/1517).

Resolved: merge commit of ros2/ros2cli#881 on rolling (2024-02-09), chosen to pair with the rolling rclpy fix; the iron backport is ros2/ros2cli#882.

failed_conditions.quote: `ros2 param dump` needs to handle empty list as exception if happens instead of proceeding zipping results. if empty result returns from parameter service, it will handle `# Parameter not set` like character array, that leads to this weird printing.

loudness_evidence: The dump command completes and prints wrong values with no diagnostic: "`ros2 param dump` reports that `param_1` is set to `#` and `param_2` is set to ` `"; the reporter adds that parameters past 19 characters "are not showed" (https://github.com/ros2/ros2/issues/1517).

resolution.summary: Consumer: ros2param dump returns None for an empty get_parameters response and prints an error to stderr instead of zipping (ros2/ros2cli#881). Provider: rclpy declare_parameter raises ValueError for a statically typed parameter declared without a value, so the node can no longer hold an uninitialized parameter that the service answers with an empty list (ros2/rclpy#1216).
resolution.evidence: Both PRs merged on rolling 2024-02-09 with CI; the issue was closed with "We merged in the fixes here, and backported the ones we could." No output of the fixed composition is shown; the reporter later wrote "If no fix is going to be merged for Iron though, I think this ticket is still \"Open\"."

notes: Canonical-form choices: GetParameters/ListParameters are service types; there is no srv form, so `msg:rcl_interfaces/<Srv>` is used for the service type and `field:rcl_interfaces/GetParameters.values` for the response field (generated type rcl_interfaces/srv/GetParameters_Response). The provider unit is the reporter's param_demo node; its parameter service is rclpy's ParameterService, so the unit is named after rclpy. The consumer also uses rclpy's AsyncParameterClient as a library; that is not the failing boundary. The maintainer's reproduction was on rolling (ros2/ros2 commit 0f10c2012877aab87ba5761fa409951eaaa4a1db, repos file with rolling branches); broken revisions here follow the reporter's iron install instead. Broken (iron) and resolved (rolling) revisions are on different branches because the rclpy fix was never backported. The ros2cli#881 change also turns two list_parameters RuntimeErrors into stderr prints; that is not part of this condition. `ros2 param get` for a single parameter works because the same empty-list convention is interpreted correctly there. Class choice: the mismatch is how an uninitialized parameter is encoded in the response (empty array vs. per-name PARAMETER_NOT_SET entries of the same length), classified representation_convention; `other` would be the alternative.
